text.EN: Morning, love. You sleep all right?
text.TL: Umaga, mahal. Matulog ka na okay?

text.EN: There you are. I was starting to miss you.
text.TL: Narito ka pala. Nagsisimula na kitang ma-miss.

text.EN: Good morning. Stay close today, okay?
text.TL: Magandang umaga po. Manatiling malapit ngayon, okay?

text.EN: Seeing you first thing still makes this place feel almost normal.
text.TL: Ang una mong makita ay halos normal pa rin ang pakiramdam ng lugar na ito.

text.EN: Morning. Whatever happens today, we handle it together.
text.TL: Umaga. Kung ano man ang mangyari ngayon, sabay nating haharapin.
